title: Dead and orphaned LFG lifecycle
ownership: Test Author owns corrections. Builder must not edit the protected corpus or this manifest; consume the immutable acceptance head and make the combined change green.
registration: The existing workspace --test '*' integration lane runs the non-ignored db-feature discord target (15 cases) with TWO_TEST_DATABASE_URL. The supervised-job case lives in the bot crate (registered via #[cfg(test)] mod in main.rs, the backfill-acceptance precedent) and runs in the workspace lib/bins unit lane with the same disposable-DB env. A source-path include of the binary's jobs.rs cannot compile: its #[cfg(test)] jobs_tests module resolves crate:: paths against the including test crate.

commands.controller: TWO_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://agent_test:@agent-testdb:5432/two_bot_test_local python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-discord --features db --test lfg_lifecycle_acceptance -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture
commands.controller_supervisor: TWO_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://agent_test:@agent-testdb:5432/two_bot_test_local python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot --bin two-bot -- lfg_lifecycle_jobs_acceptance --test-threads=1 --nocapture

safety.database: TestDatabase::create with cutover migrations, the shared disposable-DB guard, and explicit close before behavioral assertions. No fallback URL and no skipped DB setup failures.
safety.discord: Loopback MockRest only, using the real ActionExecutor proxy seam. No live Discord, staging, production or deployment.
safety.red_delivery: Branch handoff only. Do not merge a deliberately red test-only PR. Builder owns the combined implementation PR.

baseline_adapter.method: async fn sweep_lifecycle(&self, executor: &ActionExecutor, guild_id: &str, bot_user_id: u64, now: time::OffsetDateTime, limit: usize) -> Result<usize, LfgError>
baseline_adapter.meaning: The baseline has no sweep. A private test-local trait returns zero and performs no work, representing that absence while keeping the corpus compilable. A production inherent method automatically takes precedence. These adapter-driven cases are not evidence that a production sweep ran on the baseline.
baseline_adapter.count_contract: Count eligible rows processed, at most limit in one invocation. Zero limit does nothing. A settled repeat returns zero. A count alone cannot pass because real retained rows, restored IDs, freed capacity and HTTP edits are asserted independently.
baseline_adapter.compatibility: The explicitly qualified baseline method reference keeps the fallback trait live under clippy after the production inherent method is introduced.

defaults_and_limits: Choose the visible post identifier alternative of the spec (rendered member-visible text), not message-link parsing. The test never treats hidden component custom_id as discoverability.
Use the bounded job name lfg_sweep so its success/failure counters do not silently enter other.

Grace and orphan-age policy values remain builder-owned and must be documented. Fixtures deliberately use unequivocally old rows and just-created/future rows rather than invent an unspecified minute threshold.

The supervisor test is a bot-crate unit test executing the real crate::jobs supervisor and real LFG action against a disposable database. It proves the scheduling seam's behavior; it does not prove production boot registration or exclude a second ad-hoc scheduler. Builder must include boot-wiring evidence and keep the existing jobs seam as the only production scheduler.
No GREEN prototype, production source change, whole-workspace test run, runtime activation or deployment is part of this Test Author handoff.
